title: Find out why the 'encoder cannot match' copy test fails in a busy full test run
goal: A full test run on 2026-11-22 failed once in the cut-export copy tests: a recording the encoder should refuse to copy was copied instead. It passed alone and on the next full run. Find out whether a busy Mac changes the encoder's answer, and make the test steady either way.
notes: Seen in Scripts/test.sh (whole suite) during task music-longer-than-the-edit-stops-where-the-pictu, which touched only sound landing. Output: '✘ Test "A recording the encoder cannot match is left to the ordinary path" recorded an issue at PieceCopyWriterTests.swift:145:15: Expectation failed: an error was expected but none was thrown and "Outcome(copiedFrames: 48, renderedFrames: 0)" was returned' and at :152 the edit.mp4 was left behind. `Scripts/test.sh --filter aRecordingItCannotMatchIsNotCopied` passed (0.27 s), and the next full run passed (1453 tests in 231 suites). Related history: done tasks find-out-why-the-cut-export-test-fails-again-in and the-full-test-suite-stays-green-on-a-busy-mac-wh, and commit ff1766f41 (re-made frames wait for the hardware encoder).
acceptance: The cause is written in this task's log, with the run that shows it
The test passes in five full Scripts/test.sh runs in a row on this Mac
If the copy really can succeed on a busy Mac, the test says what it is checking in a way that holds then
